name: Single-Leg Back Extension
steps: Set the hip pad just below your hip crease, secure one ankle firmly beneath the roller, and let your free leg hang behind you.
Cross your arms over your chest, brace your core, and hinge forward over the pad with a flat back.
Squeeze your working glute and hamstring to raise your torso smoothly until your body forms a straight line.
Lower under control back into the hinge, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep both hips level against the pad without twisting your pelvis toward the unsupported side.
Stop rising when your torso aligns with your legs rather than hyperextending your lower back.
